messages:
Lina (support): Heads-up — customer ACME reported dashboard numbers frozen for ~3 hours, still showing yesterday's totals. They say new API calls are succeeding but console shows no rows.
Devon (eng-analytics): Which view/tenant? any alert firing?
Lina (support): tenant_id=acme-42, panes: "Hourly usage" and "Top endpoints". No pager alert yet, but user pasted screenshot.
Nora (support): I see a warning in the UI about 'data freshness degraded' when I repro.
oncall-ingest (bot): ingestion-consumer-group lag > 120k messages for topic tenant-usage (triggered 1768504390)
Devon (eng-analytics): ok that bot alert matches. @Arun can you confirm Kafka consumers? Could be connector backpressure after the deploy at 14:05 UTC.
Arun (eng-platform): Looking now — consumer group 'usage-ingest' has large lag, several partitions have stalled. Offsets show last_committed_offset stuck since 1768503300. Suspecting transient GC on the consumer instances.
Lina (support): Customer said they retried a couple API calls and saw 200s, so events in our system. They expect console to update within 15m.
Devon (eng-analytics): Quick repro queries: run this to see last processed timestamp:
```
SELECT max(event_time) FROM raw.tenant_events WHERE tenant_id='acme-42';
```
If that timestamp is old then the ingest is behind.
Arun (eng-platform): Ran it — returns 2026-03-17 10:32:01 UTC (3h behind). Consumer heap had a 90s stop-the-world GC around 1768503355, logs show: `OutOfMemoryError` then restart loop.
Devon (eng-analytics): That explains it. We need to reduce memory footprint and restart consumers safely. Is there an active rolling restart job?
Arun (eng-platform): Not yet. Plan: scale replica count from 3->5 and roll redeploy with updated JVM flags (-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=256m) to avoid OOM. I will do a controlled restart of the affected pods in k8s staging first then prod. ETA 15m.
Nora (support): Can we tell ACME what's happening and give ETA?
Lina (support): I'll message them: "We observed a consumer OOM causing ~3h backlog. Platform team is scaling and rolling pods; console should show catch-up within 30–45m after restart. Will update once catch-up begins." :thumbsup:
Devon (eng-analytics): After restart we should also trigger a short backfill job to ensure the hourly aggregates catch up faster. I'll prepare the backfill script — it re-aggregates raw events into hourly_rollups for the tenant.
Arun (eng-platform): Starting controlled pod restarts now (k8s label app=usage-ingest, ns=prod). Command used:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/usage-ingest -n prod --record
```
I'll watch consumer lag and commit offsets.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: rollout restart requested for deployment/usage-ingest by arun. Monitoring targets: consumer-lag, commit-rate, cpu, memory.
oncall-ingest (bot): consumer-lag decreased from 125183 -> 42k in last 4m
Devon (eng-analytics): Nice. Once lag < 10k, I'll kick the hourly backfill for acme-42 with this job:
```
python backfill_hourly.py --tenant acme-42 --start '2026-03-17T07:00Z' --end '2026-03-17T12:00Z'
```
That will re-run aggregations for missing windows.
Lina (support): ACME updated: they can see some partial numbers returning, thanks. I'll keep them updated.
Arun (eng-platform): Consumers healthy now, no OOMs in logs, memory stable. Rolling deploy completed.
Devon (eng-analytics): Backfill queued, monitoring aggregation throughput. Will post when hourly_rollups show new rows.
Lina (support): Customer confirms charts are back and numbers match API logs. Closing on our side once you confirm rollup completeness.
Devon (eng-analytics): Verified hourly_rollups table has rows from 10:00->12:00 for acme-42. Marking resolved. Suggestion: add alert for consumer GC pauses > 30s and add JVM metaspace guardrails to deploy config.
Arun (eng-platform): Filing infra ticket to update deploy template and add kube liveness probe tweak.
Nora (support): Thanks team :heart:
Lina (support): Closing thread — will follow up with postmortem if needed.
